# rotational_moulding
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
ROTATIONAL MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  materialFamily: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  wallThicknessMm=17  [2·V/S = 2 × 1037.0 cm³ ÷ 1220 cm² = 17.00 mm, the area-mean wall of a shell (the ray-cast mean reads 3.00 mm: rays cross the cavity and read pinch welds) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  partWeightKg: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  heatTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  coolTimeSec: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  coolingMethod: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  numArms: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  partsPerArm: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
  projectedAreaCm2=288.4  [estimated from the two largest bounding-box dimensions (no measured silhouette) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  mouldType: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (LLDPE Roto Powder (natural) | HDPE Roto Powder | Cross-Linked PE (XLPE) Roto | PP Roto Powder | PA12 Roto Powder)
